messages:
carla: Quick sync — I'm proposing a concise "Launch Entrance" rubric for the public launch of tiered inference. Need fast surface-level ok from Docs, SRE, Billing, and Support before EOD.

tom: Sounds good. Can you paste the high-level buckets?

carla: Sure — thinking 5 buckets: safety/quality gating, SLA & latency SLOs, observability + alerting, docs/runbooks, pricing & quota plan. Short checklist per bucket with an owner.

anya: I'll take docs/runbooks. Want a checklist for: quickstart, migration notes for Dedicated/Private, troubleshooting + rollback steps, and a minimal prompt-regression FAQ.

mike: For pricing/quota plan I want clear fallback pricing for low-tier vs committed pools, burst rules, and preview credits for early customers. Also a kernel on quota behavior if KV cache is enabled.

tom: On SLA/SLOs: propose keep it simple for public launch: p95 latency target <= 350ms for standard models, p95 <= 700ms for long-context; global error rate < 0.3% (5XX+timeout). Also a degradation policy: if p95 > 2x target for 15m, auto-fallback to cheaper model variant.

sre-oncall-bot: Note: auto-fallback needs a documented circuit-breaker (owner: eng-runtime) and a runbook step to roll back routing changes.

carla: Observability: must include per-model token breakdown, path from trace to user-request-id, and a burn-rate dashboard for cost per token. Alerts: SLO burn > 60% in 5m, error rate spike > 0.5% in 1m.

anya: Docs: I'll add a "Launch Quick Card" that summarizes SLA, intended workload profiles, and recommended quantization/latency knobs per customer tier. Will surface examples for SDK retry/backoff patterns.

mike: For pricing, ops wants a guardrail: limit free-tier QPS to 10 qps per account, with explicit throttle message and billing link. For Dedicated trials include a clause about overage handling during preview.

tom: Support coverage: we need Tier 1 playbook in Customer Success, and a dedicated oncall rotation for the first 72 hours post-launch for critical routing/throughput issues. Who owns the 72-hour rota? eng-platform + eng-sre pairing.

carla: Owners: Docs = anya; SLA/SLO + runbook = tom; Pricing/quota = mike; Observability dashboards = eng-infra (owner: micah, cc @tom); 72-hour rota = eng-sre lead (TBD).

anya: Question: do we require model regression tests gated before rollout? I suggest a 3k-prompt smoke set across client-critical intents with a quality floor (BLEU-like / similarity threshold) — if regression detected, block.

mike: Yes — tie regression test to rollout flag. Also need cost-sim before enabling quantization for Dedicated customers.

carla: Proposal for gating: to flip from limited beta -> public launch we need: (1) all checklist items green, (2) regression pass on smoke set, (3) SRE load test simulating 2x expected traffic for 30m with p95 within target, (4) pricing doc and billing link live, (5) 72-hour rota staffed.

tom: Timeline: if we get ok today from Docs & Pricing, eng-runtime can complete fallback wiring by Wed, infra dashboards by Thu, we can schedule the load test Fri.

anya: I'll publish the quickstart + rollback steps by EOD and link to the checklist doc.

mike: I'll update the pricing page and quota table with throttle messages, will ping finance for wording by 3pm.

carla: Perfect. Last ask — any non-negotiable blockers? Call them out now.

tom: Non-negotiable: fallback routing and rollback automation must be tested; no manual-only emergency paths.

anya: Docs: non-negotiable — a short runbook with explicit escalation steps and contact matrix.

mike: Non-negotiable: explicit overage policy for Dedicated trial customers (so sales + finance can sign).

carla: Great — I’ll compile this into a one-page Launch Entrance rubric and owner assignments, post it to the launch tracker, and we’ll reconvene tomorrow 10am for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy window scheduled 2025-05-10 02:00 UTC — confirm rota if go.

anya: Ack, will be oncall for first 12 hours.

mike: I'll be available for billing edgecases after deploy.

carla: Thanks team — closing thread, will upload the rubric doc shortly.
